captions.caption: A view of a small stream flowing through a forest with the ground covered in brown leaves.
A man in outdoor gear appears in the distance, walking along the far side of the stream.
The man continues walking upstream in the background of the forest scene.
He carefully steps on mossy rocks to navigate his way through the stream.
The man continues to cross the stream by stepping from rock to rock.
After crossing, he bends down briefly on the far bank of the stream.
The man stands up and begins to move along the opposite bank.
He continues walking along the far bank, parallel to the flowing stream.
The man begins to climb up the steep, leaf-covered bank.
He uses a tree for support as he continues climbing the bank.
He continues his ascent up the wooded, leafy bank.
Reaching the top of the bank, he starts walking towards the camera.
The man walks down the slope on the near side of the stream.
He continues walking down the leafy slope towards the camera.
He approaches the stream on the near side, preparing to cross again.
The man takes a running leap to jump over the stream.
In a motion blur, the man is captured mid-air as he jumps across the stream.
The camera angle shifts to a wider view of the stream and forest.
A wide shot of the forest, with the camera beginning to pan upwards.
The camera continues to pan up, showing the bare branches of the trees.
The upward pan reveals more of the tall, bare trees against the overcast sky.
The camera continues its slow pan up through the forest canopy.
The camera holds on a shot of the upper branches of the trees as the scene darkens.
The scene fades completely to black, transitioning to the next shot.
A new scene shows a man kneeling on the forest floor, leaning over a fire pit.
He begins to blow on the embers and kindling in the fire pit.
The embers in the fire pit glow red as the man blows on them.
He continues blowing, trying to ignite the kindling from the glowing embers.
The man keeps blowing steadily on the embers in the fire pit.
He pauses briefly before leaning in to blow on the embers again.
He blows forcefully, causing the embers to glow brighter.
The embers glow intensely as he continues to blow on the kindling.
He maintains his effort, blowing on the kindling to start a fire.
A small amount of smoke begins to rise from the kindling.
The man sits up slightly as the fire begins to catch, producing more smoke.
He leans back over the fire pit and blows on the small flame.
He continues to blow, encouraging the fire to grow.
The smoke gets thicker, and a small flame appears on the kindling.
The flame flickers and grows as he continues to blow.
The man sits up as the kindling is now properly on fire.
He leans back in to blow on the now-established flames.
The flames grow larger and brighter as he blows on them.
He continues to blow steadily, helping the fire to spread.
The fire grows stronger, producing more smoke and light.
The man sits up slightly, observing the well-lit fire.
He leans back in to give the fire one more sustained blow.
The fire responds with a burst of flame and smoke.
He continues to blow on the fire, which is now burning strongly.
The man sits up, satisfied as the campfire is now successfully lit.
He sits back on his knees, watching the fire burn in the rock pit.
A new scene shows a man inside a tent, talking to the camera.
He begins to put on a black beanie to stay warm.
He pulls the beanie down over his head with both hands.
He adjusts the fit of the beanie on his head.
He continues to adjust the beanie, pulling it down firmly.
He smooths the beanie down over his head and ears.
He makes final adjustments to the position of the beanie.
With the beanie on, he looks forward inside the tent.
The man sits inside his tent, wearing a black jacket and beanie.
He looks slightly to the side while talking inside the tent.
